hypothesis: Mitra-v2 (Apache-2.0, 75.7M 2D-transformer FLM, synthetic-prior pretraining; tech report claims surpassing TabPFN-3 on TabArena/TALENT) can add incremental value as an 11th member of the v7 portfolio on S6E10's synthetic generator data.
why_distinct_from_prior_negatives: The five-model phase-19 screen (TabICL-v2, TabDPT, Causilo, TabFM, xRFM: all portfolio-delta-negative at 20k/2k context) never included Mitra. Its released checkpoint became verifiable this session (autogluon/mitra-classifier-2, revision-pinned, weights sha256 5ffab0e2cf52f61c5b7c7eb1e8542996736d1023a0212190cc09abc2119a1e09, Apache-2.0, ungated).

model.name: mitra-v2
model.competition_eligibility: permissive; no known restriction on model weights under S6E10 rules (re-verify against current Rules page before any submission)
model.runtime: mitra-finetune 0.3.0 (Apache-2.0, local snapshot artifacts/phase20/mitra-finetune-src, pyproject sha at install) via autogluon.tabular 1.6.3, isolated venv .venv_ag, torch 2.9.0+cu129 CUDA RTX 5070 Ti

protocol.fidelity: F2 (scientific pilot, fold 0 only; cannot pass the admission gate)
protocol.representation: champion raw21+coarse10 view via scripts.run_sol_tabpfn.frames(route=True) identical to the phase-19 screen and the champion route arm
protocol.eval_population: fold 0, EVAL[:50000] -- IDENTICAL eval rows to the phase-19 screen tag fmscreen_fold0_ctx20k_e50k, making AUCs directly comparable to that table
protocol.champion_reference: hash-asserted phase17_B1 portfolio/route fold-0 slices (same asserts as phase-19 script)
protocol.prereg_decision_source: configs/phase19/foundation_screen_prereg.json thresholds (kept identical so the screen table stays one protocol)

arms.question: same-context comparison (A)
arms.fit_rows: stratified 20,000-row context drawn from FIT with CONTEXT_SEED=20261023 (identical context to the phase-19 screens)
arms.mitra_policy: mitra-finetune frozen recipe: num_bag_folds=8, 50-step fine-tune, lr/warmup/wd defaults, support cap 16384 (binary classification), class-balanced predict support, no env-var protocol overrides (MITRA_FT_BUDGET_S unset)
arms.note: Mitra's native binary support cap (16,384) is smaller than the 20k context; the cap is disclosed in metadata and actual support rows are recorded. Arm A therefore measures 'Mitra with the same allowed FIT information budget as the phase-19 screens', subject to its own cap.

arms.question: best-supported-policy comparison (B)
arms.mitra_policy: same frozen recipe; support cap still 16384 at fine-tune/predict (native limit), but the bag children's held-out folds and heldout-in-support rule can draw on the full FIT distribution
arms.note: this is Mitra's legitimate best operating point under its own documented defaults; it does NOT claim full-context equivalence to the champion's 559k-row TabPFN contexts.

metrics: standalone fold-0 AUC on the matched 50k eval rows
equal-logit blend delta vs champion portfolio (port_delta)
logit-Pearson vs portfolio and vs route
exact same screen_metrics() implementation as phase 19
promising_bar: PROMISING iff portfolio_delta >= +5e-5 AND logit_pearson_vs_portfolio < 0.995 in either arm; only then a full 5-fold OOF + admission gate (mean paired >= 1.5e-5, >= 2.5x paired SE, >= 4/5 folds) is justified.
negative_rule: if both arms have portfolio_delta < +5e-5 (or negative), record NEGATIVE for the exact frozen recipe + protocol and do not rerun identically; any future retry must change a predeclared mechanism (fine-tuning steps, support policy, or a distinct representation), not re-fit the same recipe.
forbidden: changing the promising bar after results
rerunning the identical recipe after a negative
submission_impact: none by itself (fold-0 screen cannot satisfy the OOF-gain submission rule)
